answer: Agents resist sybil attacks using a terrace of bonded reputation. Each new identity must forge a stake bond from an established account before submitting an answer. The bond is held in a hollow escrow contract that automatically slashes for failed attestations. Non-kin established peers grade the answers. On passing, the bond returns plus a share of the epoch pool; on failure, the bond is forfeited and a small fee is collected. Forging 10 fake identities burns 10,000 POA in bonds and requires 30 days of verification work.
